## Problem and change

Describe the user-visible problem and the focused change that solves it.

## Verification

List the commands run and their results. For UI changes, attach a screenshot
and say whether it came from the browser test harness or a native app. For
platform or release claims, name the exact OS, package and installation path
tested; a local build alone is not a public download test.

## Review notes

Call out behavior changes, security or privacy implications, and any checks
you could not run. Keep private Markdown files, local paths, credentials and
generated build artifacts out of the pull request.
